featuredProjects.title: Laptop Remote
featuredProjects.tagline: Turn your phone into a low-latency laptop controller over Wi-Fi
featuredProjects.description: Control your laptop from your mobile browser over local Wi-Fi with zero client install needed. Features a multi-touch trackpad, remote keyboard, media controls, and a real-time presentation laser pointer overlay across Windows, macOS, and Linux (X11 & Wayland).
highlights: Real-time WebSocket communication for ultra-low latency mouse tracking and keystrokes.
Interactive laser pointer overlay designed for presentation slides.
Mobile-first PWA interface with responsive touch gestures and native vibration feedback.

featuredProjects.title: Automated Twitter Content Poster
featuredProjects.tagline: Autonomous news synthesis & social publisher with Gemini AI
featuredProjects.description: Automated n8n workflow pipeline that ingests breaking news categories via NewsAPI every 4 hours, synthesizes human-like concise posts using Google Gemini AI, and auto-publishes to Twitter/X with fallback logging to Google Sheets.
highlights: Autonomous scheduled pipeline rotating across tech, business, and politics news categories.
Integrated Gemini AI for tone calibration (200–260 chars) with fallback recovery.
Engineered custom JS execution nodes for prompt engineering and JSON validation.

featuredProjects.title: Anna University Estate Office Portal
featuredProjects.tagline: Institutional estate & document management web application
featuredProjects.description: Full-stack institutional web app built to replace a legacy PHP system for Anna University's Estate Office. Implemented dynamic document archiving (PDFs), property directories, and real-time database management.
highlights: Replaced legacy server-rendered PHP site with a modern responsive React SPA.
Integrated PDF document uploading, metadata indexing, and viewing modules.
Built responsive administrative dashboards with dynamic form handling and MySQL transactions.

featuredProjects.title: MemeGenie – AI-Powered Meme Generator
featuredProjects.tagline: Serverless event-driven image processing on AWS
featuredProjects.description: Serverless meme generation and distribution platform running on AWS Lambda, S3, and API Gateway for scalable and automated image processing with presigned URLs and IAM access control.
highlights: Multi-bucket S3 cloud storage architecture separating input assets, web host, and processed memes.
Dynamic serverless Python Lambda function computing text bounding boxes and rendering overlays.
Generated secure 1-hour presigned retrieval URLs for low cloud cost and strict security.

featuredProjects.title: Session Export (Chrome MV3 Extension)

featuredProjects.description: Chrome Extension built with Manifest V3 to clone and migrate active browser cookies and sessions into incognito windows across multiple web domains seamlessly.
